# About the Data

This dataset comes from a [#TidyTuesday](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday) challenge (Week 9, 2026) and is sourced from the research paper "[Sex Ratio Bias Triggers Demographic Suicide in a Dense Tortoise Population](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/ele.70296)," which garnered widespread attention including coverage by [The New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/02/14/science/tortoises-island-sex-cliff.html). The study examines an exceptionally dense island population of [Hermann's tortoises](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hermann%27s_tortoise) at [Golem Grad](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Golem_Grad) in [Lake Prespa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lake_Prespa), [North Macedonia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Macedonia), where sexually coercive males dramatically outnumber females, leading to an ongoing extinction event predicted to claim its last female by 2083. The dataset was curated by [Novica Nakov of Free Software Macedonia](https://github.com/novica) and consists of two CSV files — [`clutch_size_cleaned`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-03-03/clutch_size_cleaned.csv) and [`tortoise_body_condition_cleaned`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-03-03/tortoise_body_condition_cleaned.csv) — which can be loaded in [R](https://www.r-project.org/) via the [tidytuesdayR package](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/tidytuesdayR/index.html), in [Python](https://www.python.org/) via [pydytuesday](https://pypi.org/project/pydytuesday/), or in [Julia](https://julialang.org/) via [TidierTuesday.jl](https://github.com/TidierOrg/TidierTuesday.jl).

![Data: Ivanović et al. (2025), Elements — "Sex Ratio Bias Triggers Demographic Suicide in a Dense Tortoise Population"; curated by Novica Nakov, Free Software Macedonia. Each dot represents one Hermann's tortoise (Testudo hermanni) from its most recent recorded year, coloured by locality (Beach, Konjsko, Plateau) on Golem Grad island, Lake Prespa, North Macedonia.](tidy_golem_tortoise.png){#fig-1}

## How I Made This Graphic

### Loading required libraries

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| eval: false

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse, # All things tidy

  scales, # Nice Scales for ggplot2
  fontawesome, # Icons display in ggplot2
  ggtext, # Markdown text support for ggplot2
  showtext, # Display fonts in ggplot2
  colorspace, # Lighten and Darken colours
  sf, # Spatial Features

  patchwork,  # Composing Plots
  packcircles, # for hierarchichal packing circles
  colorspace, # Modify and play with colours, extract dominant colours
  magick  # Playing with images
)

clutch_size_cleaned <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-03-03/clutch_size_cleaned.csv')
tortoise_body_condition_cleaned <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-03-03/tortoise_body_condition_cleaned.csv')
```

### Visualization Parameters

```{r}
#| label: viz-params

# Font for titles
font_add_google("Saira",
  family = "title_font"
)

# Font for the caption
font_add_google("Saira Condensed",
  family = "body_font"
)

# Font for plot text
font_add_google("Saira Extra Condensed",
  family = "caption_font"
)

showtext_auto()

# A base Colour
bg_col <- "white"
seecolor::print_color(bg_col)

# Colour for highlighted text
text_hil <- "grey20"
seecolor::print_color(text_hil)

# Colour for the text
text_col <- "grey10"
seecolor::print_color(text_col)

# Define Base Text Size
bts <- 120

# Caption stuff for the plot
sysfonts::font_add(
  family = "Font Awesome 6 Brands",
  regular = here::here("docs", "Font Awesome 6 Brands-Regular-400.otf")
)
github <- "&#xf09b"
github_username <- "aditya-dahiya"
xtwitter <- "&#xe61b"
xtwitter_username <- "@adityadahiyaias"
social_caption_1 <- glue::glue("<span style='font-family:\"Font Awesome 6 Brands\";'>{github};</span> <span style='color: {text_hil}'>{github_username}  </span>")
social_caption_2 <- glue::glue("<span style='font-family:\"Font Awesome 6 Brands\";'>{xtwitter};</span> <span style='color: {text_hil}'>{xtwitter_username}</span>")
plot_caption <- paste0(
  "**Data:**  Novica Nakov, Free Software Macedonia ",
  "   |  **Code:** ",
  social_caption_1,
  " |  **Graphics:** ",
  social_caption_2
)
rm(
  github, github_username, xtwitter,
  xtwitter_username, social_caption_1,
  social_caption_2
)

plot_title <- "Outnumbered & Overwhelmed"

plot_subtitle <- "At Golem Grad, females grow heavier than males — yet are vastly outnumbered. Sexual coercion by dominant males is driving the population toward extinction." |> 
  str_wrap(70)
```

### Exploratory Data Analysis and Wrangling

```{r}
#| label: eda

bts <- 90

df1 <- tortoise_body_condition_cleaned |> 
  group_by(individual) |> 
  slice_max(year, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |> 
  ungroup()
```

### The Plot

```{r}
#| label: base-plot

# Define Base Text Size for the plot
bts <- 90

g <- df1 |> 
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(
      x = sex,
      y = body_mass_grams,
      colour = locality,
      fill = locality
    )
  ) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(
    alpha = 0.9,
    size = 3,
    stroke = 1,
    shape = 21,
    corral.width = 1.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(600, 2500)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    expand = expansion(c(-0.08, 0.2)),
    labels = c("Females", "Males")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = "none"
  ) +
  paletteer::scale_colour_paletteer_d(
    "khroma::highcontrast"
    ) +
  paletteer::scale_fill_paletteer_d(
    "khroma::highcontrast"
    ) +
  labs(
    title = plot_title,
    subtitle = plot_subtitle,
    x = NULL,
    y = "Body Mass (in grams)",
    colour = "Locality\nof the\nTortoise",
    caption = plot_caption
  ) +
  theme_minimal(
    base_family = "body_font",
    base_size = bts
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(
      colour = text_hil, 
      margin = margin(0,0,0,0, "mm"),
      lineheight = 0.3
    ),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(1,1),
    legend.justification = c(1,1),
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(5,5,5,5, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(15, "mm"),
    legend.background = element_rect(
      fill = alpha(bg_col, 0.5),
      colour = NULL,
      linewidth = 0
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      margin = margin(10,0,10,5, "mm"),
      size = bts * 1.2
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      margin = margin(10,0,0,0, "mm"),
      size = bts * 1.2
    ),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(
      size = bts  * 1.2,
      margin = margin(0,4,0,0, "mm")
    ),
    axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(
      margin = margin(-10,0,10,0, "mm"),
      size = bts * 1.5
    ),
    axis.ticks.length.y = unit(2, "mm"),
    
    # Text elements
    plot.title = element_text(
      margin = margin(10, 0, 5, 0, "mm"),
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = bts * 3,
      face = "bold",
      colour = text_hil,
      lineheight = 0.3,
      family = "caption_font"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      margin = margin(5, 0, 0, 0, "mm"),
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = bts * 1.5,
      colour = text_hil,
      lineheight = 0.35
    ),
    plot.caption = element_textbox(
      hjust = 0.5,
      family = "caption_font",
      size = bts * 0.8,
      colour = text_hil,
      lineheight = 0.4,
      margin = margin(5, 0, 0, 0, "mm")
    ),
    
    # Plot background
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = bg_col
    ),
    
    # Plot margins - reduced to minimize white space
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5, "mm"),
    
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    axis.line.y.left = element_line(
      arrow = arrow(),
      linewidth = 0.5,
      colour = text_col
    ),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.7,
      linetype = 3,
      colour = text_col
    ),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.4,
      linetype = 3,
      colour = text_col
    ),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

# Save the plot
ggsave(
  filename = here::here(
    "data_vizs",
    "tidy_golem_tortoise.png"
  ),
  plot = g,
  width = 400,
  height = 500,
  units = "mm",
  bg = bg_col
)
```

### Savings the thumbnail for the webpage

```{r}
#| label: save-image

# Saving a thumbnail

library(magick)

# Saving a thumbnail for the webpage
image_read(
  here::here(
    "data_vizs",
    "tidy_golem_tortoise.png"
    )
  ) |>
  image_resize(geometry = "x400") |>
  image_write(
    here::here(
      "data_vizs",
      "thumbnails",
      "tidy_golem_tortoise.png"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-session-info

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse, # All things tidy

  scales, # Nice Scales for ggplot2
  fontawesome, # Icons display in ggplot2
  ggtext, # Markdown text support for ggplot2

  colorspace # Lighten and Darken colours
)

sessioninfo::session_info()$packages |>
  as_tibble() |>
  
  # The attached column is TRUE for packages that were 
  # explicitly loaded with library()
  dplyr::filter(attached == TRUE) |>
  dplyr::select(package,
    version = loadedversion,
    date, source
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(package) |>
  janitor::clean_names(
    case = "title"
  ) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::opt_interactive(
    use_search = TRUE
  ) |>
  gtExtras::gt_theme_espn()
```
